title: WorkTrace Tab Vault module — v1
description: Per-user saved tab groups. One file per user at modules/tabgroups/data.json in the user's private data repo. Unlike Timesheet, this module is BROWSER-EDITABLE — the dashboard writes it directly via the user's PAT (ctx.saveMyData). Phase 1 is manual (add/paste URLs). Phase 2's companion Chrome extension writes the same shape: it fills `color`/`source` from chrome.tabGroups when importing a native group. No credentials are ever stored here.

id.description: Stable group id, e.g. 'grp_ab12cd34'. Generated in the browser.

name.description: User-facing group name. Phase 2 seeds this from the Chrome tab-group title on import.

color.description: Chrome tab-group colour key (matches chrome.tabGroups.color). null for a custom folder that never came from a Chrome group; the UI falls back to grey.

source.description: 'manual' = created/typed in the dashboard. 'chrome' = imported from a native Chrome tab group by the Phase 2 extension.

collapsed.description: Whether the group is collapsed in the detail view. Mirrors the Chrome tab-group collapsed state on Phase 2 import.

url.description: http/https URL of the saved tab.

title.description: Display title. Defaults to the hostname; Phase 2 can seed the real tab title.

favicon.description: Reserved for Phase 2 — the extension can supply the tab's favIconUrl. Unused in Phase 1.

added_at.description: When the link was saved to the vault.
